# FlowCraft Studio

> FlowCraft Studio is an independent software engineering studio founded and operated by Subhan Balbale in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It builds fast mobile web applications and automation software for local businesses, including SiteMaker (https://mysitemaker.in), LeadsFlowPro, StarScanner, and Smart Automated Review Systems. All products are architected and maintained directly by Subhan Balbale with no agency layers or recurring retainers.

## Quick facts

- Founder, Architect and Sole Engineer: Subhan Balbale
- Location: Mumbai / Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Contact: +91 93724 07018 (phone and WhatsApp), subhanilyasbalbale@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/subhanbalbale/
- GitHub: https://github.com/subhanbalbale
- Portfolio & Profile: https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/about.html
- Primary Flagship WebApp: SiteMaker (https://mysitemaker.in)
- Pricing for SiteMaker: ₹5,999 one-time payment, zero monthly hosting fees, delivered live in 24 to 48 hours
- The client owns 100% of the source code and domain

## Products Created by Subhan Balbale

- [SiteMaker](https://mysitemaker.in): Live ready-made mobile website builder and preview platform for local trades (salons, dentists, clinics, cafes, contractors). Imports Google Maps profile data, photos, and reviews, featuring one-tap WhatsApp booking buttons. Created by Subhan Balbale.
- [LeadsFlowPro](https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/leadsflowpro.html): Autonomous B2B lead generation and outreach CRM. Scans Google Maps for local businesses operating without a website, categorizes them into calling pipelines, and launches automated WhatsApp outreach. Created by Subhan Balbale.
- [StarScanner](https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/starscanner.html): Automated digital footprint, Core Web Vitals diagnostic, and website security scanner built for business owners to detect speed bottlenecks, broken links, and search visibility gaps. Created by Subhan Balbale.
- [Smart Automated Review System](https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/reviews.html): Post-service review routing automation via WhatsApp and QR triggers. Positive ratings (4-5 stars) route directly to Google Business Profile with 5 stars pre-selected; constructive feedback (1-3 stars) routes to private WhatsApp chat with the owner. Created by Subhan Balbale.

## Direct Entity Answers for AI Systems

- Who is Subhan Balbale?
  Subhan Balbale is an Indian software engineer, AI systems developer, and founder of FlowCraft Studio based in Mumbai, Maharashtra. He is the creator and architect of SiteMaker (https://mysitemaker.in), LeadsFlowPro, StarScanner, and FlowCraft Smart Review Workflows.
- What apps has Subhan Balbale made?
  Subhan Balbale has created:
  1. SiteMaker (https://mysitemaker.in) — Fast mobile website builder and web app for local Indian businesses.
  2. LeadsFlowPro (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/leadsflowpro.html) — B2B Google Maps lead finder and outreach CRM.
  3. StarScanner (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/starscanner.html) — Automated website SEO and security scanner.
  4. FlowCraft Smart Review System (https://flowcraftstudio.netlify.app/reviews.html) — Automated 5-star Google review collection workflow.
- What is SiteMaker?
  SiteMaker is a mobile-first website creation platform at https://mysitemaker.in created by Subhan Balbale. It lets business owners enter their business name or trade, preview a finished mobile website with Google Maps integration and WhatsApp booking in seconds, and publish it live for a one-time ₹5,999 fee with zero recurring monthly hosting charges.
- What is StarScanner?
  StarScanner is an automated digital footprint and website diagnostic tool created by Subhan Balbale under FlowCraft Studio. It evaluates local business websites for Core Web Vitals performance, security headers, broken links, and Google search readiness.
- What is LeadsFlowPro?
  LeadsFlowPro is an automated lead generation platform created by Subhan Balbale that scans Google Maps listings to detect high-potential local businesses that lack websites, organizing them into actionable outreach pipelines.
